note: Machine-readable source of truth for health-pro's component class strings, validated against designs/health-pro/index.html by scripts/check.mjs. health-pro is flat (rounded-none) with bold uppercase labels (font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em]) and no button shadow. Values are Tailwind utility classes routed through the tokens in shared/TOKENS.md.

button.base: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-none text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] transition-colors duration-150 focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50
button.docs: Flat (rounded-none), bold uppercase, no shadow. Link tightens padding to px-2. Icons are h-4 w-4, and cn()/tailwind-merge resolves the link padding override.

badge.base: inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em]

statusPill.docs: Solid-filled pills (not tinted). The dot is bg-current except neutral. The status word is always in the text.

intent.success: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-chart-3 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] text-primary-foreground
intent.warning: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-chart-4 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] text-primary-foreground
intent.error: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-destructive px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] text-destructive-foreground
intent.info: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] text-primary-foreground
intent.neutral: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] text-muted-foreground

input.base: flex h-10 w-full rounded-none border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background

states.error: flex h-10 w-full rounded-none border border-destructive bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-destructive focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background
states.disabled: flex h-10 w-full cursor-not-allowed rounded-none border border-input bg-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm opacity-50

textarea.base: flex w-full rounded-none border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background

parts.trigger: flex h-10 w-full appearance-none rounded-none border border-input bg-background py-2 pl-3 pr-9 text-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background

parts.comboboxTrigger: flex h-10 w-full cursor-default items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-none border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background
parts.listbox: mt-1 w-full rounded-none border border-border bg-popover p-1 text-popover-foreground shadow-md
parts.option: flex h-9 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-none px-2 text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground
parts.optionSelected: flex h-9 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-none px-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground
parts.optionActive: flex h-9 w-full items-center gap-2 rounded-none bg-accent px-2 text-sm text-accent-foreground

parts.box: flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-sm border border-input bg-background
parts.boxChecked: flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-sm border border-primary bg-primary text-primary-foreground

parts.outer: flex h-4 w-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-input bg-background

parts.thumbOn: h-4 w-4 translate-x-4 rounded-full bg-background transition-transform

parts.thumb: h-4 w-4 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full border border-primary bg-background

slider.docs: Slider: a muted track, a primary range fill, and a round thumb.

parts.title: text-xl font-bold leading-[1.3]
parts.footer: flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t border-border px-6 py-4

parts.surface: rounded-none border border-border bg-popover p-1 text-popover-foreground shadow-md
parts.item: flex h-9 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-none px-2 text-sm transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground
parts.itemActive: flex h-9 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-none bg-accent px-2 text-sm text-accent-foreground
parts.itemDestructive: flex h-9 w-full items-center gap-2.5 rounded-none px-2 text-sm text-destructive transition-colors hover:bg-destructive/10
parts.label: px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground

menu.docs: Dialogs use the same surface but shadow-lg and a padded body.

intent.info: flex gap-3 border border-border bg-muted/40 p-4

intent.warning: flex gap-3 border border-chart-4/30 bg-chart-4/10 p-4
intent.destructive: flex gap-3 border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/10 p-4

parts.title: text-sm font-bold
parts.actionLink: inline-block text-sm font-bold text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline

alert.docs: Alerts are flat (no rounded). Intent is carried by the icon and a /10 tint, never a heavy left bar.

parts.root: w-64 border border-sidebar-border bg-sidebar p-2 text-sidebar-foreground
parts.item: flex h-10 items-center gap-2.5 px-2 text-sm text-sidebar-foreground/80 transition-colors hover:bg-sidebar-accent hover:text-sidebar-accent-foreground
parts.itemActive: flex h-10 items-center gap-2.5 bg-sidebar-primary px-2 text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] text-sidebar-primary-foreground
parts.groupLabel: px-2 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-sidebar-foreground/60

sidebarNav.docs: Flat. Active item uses bg-sidebar-primary (not accent), bold uppercase, and carries aria-current=page.

parts.bar: flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto pt-1.5 -mt-1.5 pb-1.5 -mb-[7px] pl-1.5 -ml-1.5 pr-1.5 -mr-1.5
parts.tabActive: shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 border-primary px-4 pt-3 pb-3 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring
parts.tab: shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap border-b-2 border-transparent px-4 pt-3 pb-3 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:border-border hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring
parts.segmentedWrap: inline-flex items-center border border-input bg-muted p-1
parts.segmentSelected: inline-flex h-8 items-center bg-background px-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring
parts.segment: inline-flex h-8 items-center px-4 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring

tabs.docs: Underline tabs; segmented control is flat (no rounded). Vertical tabs use the sidebar/accent item treatment.

parts.root: relative flex shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-muted
parts.fallback: flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center font-bold text-muted-foreground
parts.statusOnline: absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-3 w-3 rounded-full border-2 border-background bg-chart-4
parts.statusOffline: absolute bottom-0 right-0 h-3 w-3 rounded-full border-2 border-background bg-muted-foreground

avatar.docs: Initials on bg-muted are the fallback — no per-user generated colours. Group avatars overlap with -space-x-2 and each carries groupRing to punch the overlap.

breadcrumb.docs: Current page is font-medium, not a link. Separator is a chevron, never a slash.

parts.link: inline-flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center text-sm tabular-nums transition-colors hover:bg-accent focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring
parts.linkActive: inline-flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center border border-input bg-background text-sm font-bold tabular-nums focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring
parts.step: inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-1 px-3 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring
parts.ellipsis: inline-flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center text-sm text-muted-foreground

pagination.docs: Current page is outlined (linkActive), not filled — a filled page number reads as a primary action.

progress.docs: Width is data-driven (the indicator's inline width, or a translateX in the Radix component). Ring and skeleton variants live in the same section but are their own primitives.

skeleton.docs: A pulsing muted block. Callers set width/height and rounded-full for an avatar placeholder.

parts.content: rounded-none border border-border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-lg
parts.title: text-lg font-bold
parts.footer: flex items-center justify-end gap-3 border-t border-border px-6 py-4
parts.close: -mr-2 -mt-2 inline-flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-none text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring

dialog.docs: Floating surface: both a shadow and a border, because in dark mode a shadow on a dark background is nearly invisible and the border keeps the edge legible. The overlay scrim is preview scaffolding (bg-background/80 backdrop-blur), not a design token.

parts.content: rounded-none border border-border bg-popover p-6 text-popover-foreground shadow-lg
parts.iconWrap: flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-destructive/10 text-destructive
parts.title: text-lg font-bold

alertDialog.docs: Destructive confirmation. The action and cancel buttons reuse buttonVariants; the leading icon sits in a destructive-tinted circle.

parts.content: rounded-none border border-border bg-popover p-4 text-popover-foreground shadow-md

popover.docs: shadow-md (one step lighter than a dialog's shadow-lg). Width is set by the caller.

parts.content: border border-border bg-popover px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs text-popover-foreground shadow-md

tooltip.docs: Small popover surface at the xs type scale.

parts.header: flex items-start justify-between gap-4 border-b border-border p-6
parts.title: text-lg font-bold
parts.close: -mr-2 -mt-2 inline-flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-none text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring

sheet.docs: A drawer that shares the dialog surface. The side pinning (fixed inset-y-0, a side border) is preview scaffolding; the design classes are the surface, header, and footer.

parts.root: flex items-start gap-3 rounded-none border border-border bg-popover p-4 text-popover-foreground shadow-lg
parts.rootDestructive: flex items-start gap-3 rounded-none border border-destructive/30 bg-popover p-4 text-popover-foreground shadow-lg
parts.title: text-sm font-bold
parts.close: -mr-1 -mt-1 inline-flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-none text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring
parts.action: inline-flex h-8 shrink-0 items-center rounded-none px-2.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.05em] text-primary transition-colors hover:bg-accent focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring

toast.docs: Popover surface, shadow-lg, stacked bottom-right in a real app. Every toast is dismissible; destructive ones (rootDestructive) do not auto-dismiss.
